body.statement: As the first D0 obligation, determine whether the synchronizer--two-permutation square satisfies \[\sup_{T\ge1}T^{-1/2}\mathbb E\sup_{(\lambda,\vartheta)\in[0,1]^2}\left|\sum_{t=1}^T m_t(\lambda,\vartheta)\right|<\infty.\] An affirmative answer must give a bound uniform on the entire two-parameter square and then determine whether its predictable-scale argument localizes over every face of \(\Theta(P)\) to prove \[\mathbb E_{\Pr_{P,\rho,b,o}}\sup_{q\in\Theta(P)}|M_T(q)|\le \frac{511B d^{dk}}{\epsilon}\sqrt T\quad\text{for every }T\ge1.\] A negative answer must give an explicit horizon-dependent \(\lambda_T,\vartheta_T\) counterselection and derive the sharp replacement rate for \(\mathbb E_{\Pr_{P,\rho,b,o}}D_T(P,\rho,b,o,E_T)\) on the unchanged model class.
body.justification: The two-parameter square is the smallest unsolved interior face and the mandatory falsification test for the whole-polytope parametric rate.
body.gap: HaughSingal2026Casino, arXiv version 3, pages 9--11, Sections 4.2--4.3, assumes exogenous noise vectors independent across time, independence of transition and emission noise, a direct intervention fixing the hidden state to the fair die, ambiguity only in the time-homogeneous emission coupling, and an irreducible aperiodic hidden chain. It proves asymptotic full identification of time-averaged EWAC under those restrictions, not a finite root-\(T\) rate over the complete stationary response-program fiber. No model-class inclusion or transfer is asserted. deLaPenaLaiShao2009 and RakhlinSridharanTewari2015 provide general maximal-inequality tools but do not evaluate this posterior-normalized response-polytope family at vanishing response masses.
body.consumer: The result either supplies the first uniform ingredient for the conditional root-rate theorem or identifies the sharp slower headline rate through a legal face of the same causal model.

obligation.what_is_open: The legal triangle is embedded and its three boundary edges have root-\(T\) control, but a horizon-uniform two-parameter maximal inequality on its interior and a root-\(T\) maximal bound on all of \(\Theta(P)\) remain unproved.
obligation.obstruction: Fixed-parameter martingale concentration and all one-dimensional boundary estimates do not control a parameter chosen from the square after seeing the record. Near the noncontracting corner, transverse derivatives accumulate for order \(T\) steps before damping, so a Euclidean net or an unweighted derivative integral introduces a \(\sqrt{\log T}\) loss. In the full polytope, recursive filtering is polynomial rather than affine in \(q\), so vertex or edge control does not imply control of interior extrema.
obligation.attempted: The exact legal binary construction and reparameterization to the triangle \(0\le u\le1\), \(-u\le v\le u\) isolate the two random affine updates and verify fixed-parameter root-\(T\) control. Abel summation handles all three boundary edges. Direct \(\ell_1\) covering of \(\Theta(P)\) proves an unconditional whole-polytope \(O(\sqrt{T\log T})\) maximal scale, hence \(O(\sqrt{\log T/T})\) expected diameter. The direct absolute-value estimate from a two-dimensional fundamental-theorem-of-calculus expansion has a mixed-derivative bound that is not integrable with a horizon-independent constant at the noncontracting corners. No legal horizon-dependent interior counterselection with divergent normalized width has been derived.
obligation.partial_result: The proved theorem \texttt{thm:legal-triangle-and-universal-logarithmic-bound} supplies the explicit legal response-law face, specifies \(R_0\), identifies its recursion with \(M_T\) and a sharp-interval subrange, proves fixed-parameter and full-boundary root-\(T\) control, and establishes the unconditional complete-fiber \(O(\sqrt{\log T/T})\) expected-diameter bound. It does not settle the two-dimensional interior root-\(T\) supremum or the complete-fiber root-\(T\) upper bound.
